mappingMethod: relative KES projection followed by one global elastic scale evaluated on a collision-supported Cusick free-fall fixture; not an SI-to-Blender unit conversion

contactHypothesis.method: shared bounded engineering prior used to isolate density and elastic-property differences in the first Blender calibration render
contactHypothesis.source: not measured; must be replaced by fabric-body and fabric-fabric calibration evidence

propertySemantics.clothSettings.compression_stiffness: in-plane compression and buckling spring proxy derived from projected stretch stiffness
propertySemantics.properties.compressionKpa: through-thickness compression; deliberately unmapped because Blender surface compression stiffness is not the same physical quantity
propertySemantics.clothSettings.collider_friction: dynamic contact hypothesis on the cloth
propertySemantics.collisionObject.collision.cloth_friction: static contact hypothesis on the collider

calibrationFixture.purpose: diagnostic search before final validation on the published approximately 4 mm mesh resolution
calibrationFixture.supportConstraint: no pin group; the planar specimen starts 5 mm above the solid disk and falls freely onto its collision surface

searchPolicy.policy: extend the corrected free-fall search above the former 0.01 upper endpoint without changing geometry, friction, targets, metrics, or acceptance thresholds
searchPolicy.reason: the 0.01 endpoint minimized the objective and increased projected area for five of six materials, while direct images still showed unsupported annular collapse
